About Barcelona

Barcelona pairs Mediterranean beaches with Gaudi's surreal architecture, Gothic lanes and a famous food-and-football culture.

Best time to visit Barcelona

The sweet spot is generally May–Jun & Sep — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

Top things to do in Barcelona

  • Marvel at the Sagrada Familia
  • Stroll Park Guell
  • Wander the Gothic Quarter and Las Ramblas
  • Relax on Barceloneta beach
  • Graze a tapas crawl

Good to know

Generally safe. Language: Spanish, Catalan. Visa for US passports: Visa-free, 90 days.
